is: Composition (lib/main) plus the cross-cutting HTTP concerns (extractors, problem, wire_time, sweep) around the route groups and the generated contract module.
conventions: Handlers translate HTTP ↔ use-case Commands/Outputs only; no domain logic here.
The sweeper is the only place the system (not a participant) acts on a commission.

fs.name: dev_profile.rs
fs.role: cfg(feature = "dev-profile"): the environment lock (OutsideDev), adapter-mem stores seeded with identity's and commission's fixtures, FixedSignIn as alice, an unreachable profile source and pool, sessions in tower-sessions' MemoryStore

fs.name: extract.rs
fs.role: CallingUser extractor — session → Did → UserId, 401 on absence

fs.name: generated/
fs.role: @generated prost structs + pbjson canonical-ProtoJSON serde; drift fails contract_current

fs.name: lib.rs
fs.role: app() composition + no-store header layer; ports/Config now shared via the composition crate

fs.name: main.rs
fs.role: boot: .env, config, tracing, then the profile's app — everyday: pool, migrations, Postgres session layer (http-cookies), live pg/atproto adapters, sweeper + reaper; with the `dev-profile` feature: dev_profile::app instead — then serve, logging the bound address

fs.name: problem.rs
fs.role: the single RFC 9457 error type and its code→URN mapping

fs.name: routes/
fs.role: per-domain route groups, each a *_router() builder

fs.name: sweep.rs
fs.role: deadline sweeper background task; single-writer via pg_try_advisory_xact_lock

fs.name: wire_time.rs
fs.role: canonical ProtoJSON Timestamp (Z-normalized, 0/3/6/9 digits) both directions; fallible TryFrom<WireTimestamp> for DateTimeUtc (OutOfWireRange) for use-case Commands
